# J. Leaders Realty

> Independent real estate brokerage serving western Iowa and the Omaha, Nebraska metro. Licensed in Iowa (firm F06561000) and Nebraska (firm 20230475). Based in Shelby, Iowa. Known for acreages, rural property, small towns and luxury homes, with a dedicated marketing campaign and property website for every listing. Brand: "Lead Different."

Office: 402.773.8511 · Broker/Owner: Jamie Leaders (402.306.6255)
Service area: Council Bluffs, Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, La Vista, Gretna, Bellevue, Carter Lake, Minden, Neola, Avoca, Shelby, Harlan, Missouri Valley, Underwood, Treynor, Okoboji, and acreages across Pottawattamie, Harrison, Shelby, Mills and Cass counties in Iowa.
Track record: 336+ closed sales (buyers, sellers and investors), $70M+ in total sales, 28 combined years of team experience. 38 acreage and rural sales since 2017.

## Key pages
- [Home page](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/): listings, recent sales, team, FAQ
- [Our listings](https://homes.jleadersrealty.org/): each JLR listing has its own property website

- [Seller net sheet](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/#value): estimate take-home proceeds
- [Our team](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/#team): Jamie Leaders, Kris Brockhoff, Susie Stortenbecker, Allison Andersen, Harlie Leaders

## Community guides
- [Council Bluffs, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/council-bluffs/): luxury homes, Loess Hills acreages, neighborhoods, schools, monthly market snapshot
- [Minden, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/minden/): new construction after the 2024 tornado, acreages, Tri-Center schools
- [Neola, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/neola/): family neighborhoods, Meyering Addition lots, city housing programs, Arrowhead Park
- [Omaha Metro, NE](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/omaha-metro/): Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, La Vista, Gretna and Bellevue; licensed in Nebraska and Iowa; what every J. Leaders listing gets
- [Avoca, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/avoca/): Main Street events, AHSTW schools, pool, library, grocery store; 22 Avoca-area closings
- [Underwood, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/underwood/): I-80 commute, Underwood schools, Loess Hills acreages, Fourth of July at UMBA Hall; 14 Underwood-area closings
- [Western Iowa Acreage Guide](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/acreages/): 12-point acreage checklist (Iowa septic Time of Transfer, wells, rural water, fences, zoning, USDA financing)
